function.arguments:
{"command": "python3 - <<'PY'
from tools import normalize, word_counts

print("sample:", normalize("data/sample.csv"))
print("missing:", normalize("data/missing.csv"))
print("counts:", word_counts(normalize("data/sample.csv")))

# edge cases
import tempfile, os, pathlib
d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
p = os.path.join(d, "edge.csv")
with open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write("   \n# comment\n\n#no-space-comment\n  # indented comment\na,b,#not-comment-in-3rd\nx\nx,y\nx,y,\nx,y, z \n")
print("edge:", normalize(p))
print("edge counts:", word_counts(normalize(p)))

# trailing fields > 3, empty third field, short rows
rows = [["a","b",""], ["a","b"], [], ["a","b","k","extra"], ["a","b"," k "]]
print("counts2:", word_counts(rows))

# path type / absolute / not-a-file
print("dir path:", normalize("data"))
print("abs:", normalize(os.path.abspath("data/sample.csv")))
PY
echo "exit=$?""}
